checks.label: not up two days in a row

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

claude.reason: The mechanical grade is A (8.5) but two recorded FAILs pull it down: Y fails because this would be the fourth breakout of the move (three prior breakouts already logged in 54 sessions), and RE fails because the burst bar at 3.6% range is only 69% of the widest bar in the prior five sessions — the burst is not expanding range meaningfully. The base itself looks orderly in the shaded region, but the trend is visibly mature with repeated pushes visible from June through October, and the prior-breakout note confirms only 1 of 4 worked.
claude.key_risk: A fourth breakout from a 54-session, 41% move with a sub-expansion burst bar has poor historical follow-through odds for this name.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the base high near 89.44 or if the stock opens below the prior close of 81.00 showing no follow-through.
